meta.name: knowledge-agent
meta.description: Build and query AI-powered knowledge bases from claude-mem observations. Use when users want to create focused "brains" from their observation history, ask questions about past work patterns, or compile expertise on specific topics.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从对话历史构建可查询的知识库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望从日常对话中自动提炼知识并随时查询
copy.tagline_en: Build queryable knowledge bases from conversation history
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to automatically extract knowledge from daily conversations and query it anytime

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能根据 claude-mem 的观察记录,按项目、概念等条件把历史内容整理成知识库;创建后可为知识库加载上下文(prime),然后回答关于其中内容的问题,并支持列出、重建、重新加载知识库。
howto.when: 当用户想从观察历史中建立专门的知识库、询问过往工作模式,或把特定主题整理成经验时触发。

say.text: 把 claude-mem 里关于 hooks 的观察建成一个知识库。
say.note: 会触发 build_corpus,按概念筛选历史记录。

say.text: 加载 hooks 知识库,然后问:五个生命周期钩子分别在什么时候触发?
say.note: 先 prime 再 query,在知识库上下文中作答。

say.text: 列出当前所有知识库,并显示它们的状态。
say.note: 调用 list_corpora 查看列表和统计。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can build focused knowledge bases from claude-mem observations, filtered by project, concept, etc. It can load a corpus into a session (prime), then answer questions from that corpus, and list, rebuild, or reprime corpora.
howto.when_en: Triggers when users want to create a focused knowledge base from observation history, ask questions about past work patterns, or compile expertise on a specific topic.

say_en.text: Build a knowledge base from the claude-mem observations about hooks.
Prime the hooks corpus, then ask: when does each of the five lifecycle hooks fire?
say_en.note: Primes the corpus, then queries it in context.

say_en.text: List all current knowledge bases and show their status.
say_en.note: Calls list_corpora for stats and priming status.
